20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 20 satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed. Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP claims about the Services or Deliverables, for Vendor breach of Applicable Law, for a Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, and for Vendor gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Notice, control of defence and cooperation are set out, Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-supplied material and Customer breach of law, and indemnity obligations are Excluded Claims from the cap.
